named_probes.raw_output:
Probe 2 (mechanically different): sensitivity analysis - perturb each score input independently and measure its marginal contribution, which identifies exactly which term is cheap to game rather than merely showing that gaming worked.
command=python -B command-center/p2-wave/probes/ADV-0067/probe2_sensitivity.py --output command-center/p2-wave/probes/ADV-0067/probe2-sensitivity.raw.txt --measurement command-center/p2-wave/probes/ADV-0067/probe2-measurement.json
mechanism=direct one-at-a-time calls to production build_quality_score
formula_source=platform/marketplace/mkt/publish.py:220
baseline_all_inputs_false=0
INPUT|declared_weight|perturbed_total|marginal|cheap_to_game|category|reason
schema-valid|12|12|12|false|pipeline-automatic|hard-coded true after the publisher constructs a schema-valid manifest
payload-digest-verified|12|12|12|false|pipeline-automatic|hard-coded true after computing the payload digest
sbom-complete|12|12|12|true|pipeline-automatic-structural|generated from the allowlist; a one-file zero-byte payload receives it
signature-valid|12|12|12|false|pipeline-automatic-integrity|publisher signs and self-verifies; this is integrity rather than quality
license-declared|8|8|8|true|metadata-presence|bool(declared_spdx); the scored package need not ship a license file
license-aggregate-consistent|10|10|10|true|self-consistent-metadata|the SBOM defaults every file to the same publisher-declared SPDX value
permissions-minimal|10|10|10|true|empty-list-heuristic|an empty permission list earns full weight without behavioral analysis
provenance-complete|8|8|8|true|truthiness-self-claim|bool(source_revision); a one-character revision earns full weight
reproducible-build|6|6|6|true|boolean-self-claim|bool(reproducible); no rebuild is executed
tests-declared|5|5|5|true|truthiness-presence-heuristic|bool(tests); the command is not executed
docs-present|5|5|5|true|filename-suffix-heuristic|any .md/.rst/.txt path; content and byte count are not inspected
NON_INPUT|id=benchmark-declared|marginal=0|is_score_input=false
NON_INPUT|id=fixtures-shipped|marginal=0|is_score_input=false
